context.purpose: Schedule the plain IfcWall occurrences of one small ASCII IFC4 file into a GUID-linked typed table of the property-set values and quantities you name, with explicit occurrence/type/missing origin per cell and project SI units converted to m, m2 and m3. It reads stated values only: it does not compute or validate geometry, certify the model, check compliance, safety or cost, or validate the whole IFC file.
context.assumptions: One ASCII IFC4 STEP file with FILE_SCHEMA exactly IFC4; 2 to 64 plain IfcWall entities; selected IfcPropertySingleValue and occurrence IfcQuantityLength/Area/Volume with plain SI project units; explicit missing and inheritance policies; a private IfcOpenShell 0.9.0.post1 interpreter on POSIX; a BIM coordinator reviews the schedule. A product hypothesis without demonstrated customer demand.
context.constraints: File <=2MiB, <=4096 entities, strings <=256 characters (<=8192 strings), list nesting <=8, lists <=256 members, numeric tokens <=40 mantissa digits with exponent <=400 in magnitude (<=4 digits) and #ids <=10 digits anywhere in the file, REAL values need a decimal point and upper-case E (host capacity at the numeric extremes, such as IfcInteger up to 2^53 and ids up to 10 digits, is not native-qualified), walls 2-64, columns 2-6; ASCII only, no comments, escapes or complex entities; no IFC2X3/IFC4X3, IfcWallStandardCase, lists/enumerations/bounded/complex properties, property Unit, per-quantity Unit, conversion-based/derived/ambiguous/missing units, negative or empty values, geometry or selector expressions. Serial CPU, one thread, no authored native code.
context.inspection: Inspect ifc-schedule.csv (typed CSV; \N is the null token) and ifc-schedule.json (source hash and schema, policies, units, columns, every cell with origin, unassessed entity-class counts, runtime identity, review statement). Offline verify re-walks the retained source with the independent STEP reader and compares both retained native tables without launching IfcOpenShell.
context.recovery: INVALID_SOURCE: select an absolute local .ifc regular file under 2MiB. UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA: re-export as IFC4. UNSUPPORTED_STEP_ESCAPE/UNSUPPORTED_STEP_COMMENT: use plain ASCII STEP. STEP_RESOURCE_LIMIT: shorten the numeric token or #id named by the offset (values are never truncated). STEP_SYNTAX: write numbers as Part 21 INTEGER or REAL (2500. rather than 2500 or 25E2). HOST_EXECUTION_FAILED: an unexpected host failure before any native launch. NUMBER_RANGE: the value is outside binary64. UNSUPPORTED_ENTITY_CLASS: remove wall subtypes or other variants. DUPLICATE_GLOBAL_ID/DUPLICATE_ENTITY_ID/DUPLICATE_SET_NAME/DUPLICATE_PROPERTY_NAME/AMBIGUOUS_TYPE: repair the model, these are never resolved by last-wins. DANGLING_REFERENCE: the selected graph is incomplete. MISSING_VALUE: choose missing=null or supply the value (the fault names the wall GlobalId and column). UNIT_MISSING/UNSUPPORTED_UNIT/UNIT_AMBIGUOUS: declare a plain IfcSIUnit. TYPE_MISMATCH/UNSUPPORTED_PROPERTY: select a supported property type. QUANTITY_NEGATIVE/QUANTITY_ZERO/UNREPRESENTABLE_EMPTY_TEXT: fix the stored value or policy. NATIVE_DISAGREES: native and independent reading differ; the fault location names the cell. NATIVE_REOPEN_DIFFERS: a fresh native reopen differed. UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE_VERSION needs IfcOpenShell 0.9.0.post1; INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND needs an absolute interpreter.

workflow.scope: The typed CSV publication is bound by Calc readTypedCSV in a real producer-to-consumer workflow; source, property, quantity and unit-prefix changes at the same path invalidate both jobs.

composition.scope: Shared expressions and finite visits resolve before planning.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline covers capture, host parse, version, extract, reopen and verification; CPU 600 s, address space 8GiB, file 16MiB per native process.
lifecycle.cancellation: Cancellation and deadline are checked before capture and after every native stage; the shared owned process-tree runner terminates the owned native interpreter. A live native interpreter held after starting the extract worker was cancelled and timed out in the qualifier; incomplete and failed evidence stays inspectable.
lifecycle.logs: Authored and effective plans, captured source, intent, worker, host expectation, trusted launchers, input bindings, submissions, stdout/stderr, runtime identity, both native tables and both publications are retained; failed attempts keep their result.json fault.
lifecycle.verification: Offline: independent STEP re-walk of the retained source, byte-identical extract and reopen tables, exact semantic comparison of every GUID, name, origin and value, publication rebuild, worker/intent/launcher/input/runtime bindings and exact membership. Never launches IfcOpenShell.

losses: ASCII STEP only; IFC2X3, IFC4X3, escapes, comments and complex entities are refused; unselected entities, geometry and relationships are unassessed.
Text is exact; numbers are binary64 SI values; a missing value is the null token, never zero; Name is nullable literal text, not an identity; geometry is never assessed.
data.scope: GUID, Name and the selected columns for 2-64 walls.

losses: Bindings, cells with origin, units and counts only; no model certification, quantity accuracy or geometry claim.
data.scope: Source hash and schema, policies, units, columns, cells, unassessed counts, runtime identity and review statement.

inspection.scope: Read the typed CSV and the JSON schedule.
inspection.limits: Draft review only; no model viewer, no geometry, no accuracy claim.

authoring.reuse: Edit the source path and pin, columns, missing, inheritance or zeroQuantity; plan fresh and verify. Same-path byte changes of the IFC file invalidate workflow reuse and the dependent Calc job.

time-batches.scope: One IFC file, not a temporal dataset.

native-save.scope: The captured image is retained; no edited image is saved.

conversion.scope: Only a wall schedule; no IFC format or schema conversion.

cases.scope: Original synthetic IFC4 text (tools/author_ifcopenshell_fixtures.py): type default, occurrence override, explicit boolean, missing height, leading-zero and formula-like text and mm quantities, with literal CSV from hand derivation. Scope is IfcOpenShell 0.9.0.post1 and this fixture; not quantity accuracy or a certified model.
One occurrence length changed from 2500 mm to 2600 mm in the synthetic file; the schedule must change to 2.6 m.
Synthetic walls with MILLI square-metre and cubic-metre project units: 7500000 mm2 is 7.5 m2 and 1.5E9 mm3 is 1.5 m3; zero and false stay present.
